summary: Operator site live (Squarespace, phone matches): full-hookup 30/50 A pull-throughs to 80 ft, showers, laundry, wifi, open year round. No rate posted anywhere readable (campendium 403); RV Life $$ avg $31. Google 4.6/166. Pin at the office, fine. Not waterfront.
flags: PRICE: no posted rate on the operator site; RV Life price_level 2 (avg $31). No booking engine (phone/same-day reservations per a review). Price gate not testable from a posted rate, but RV Life's $$ puts it well under $50.

LONG-STAY (mild): operator welcomes stays of 'a few months while working' and 'people that have traveling occupations'; imagery shows ~6 long-term units along the west edge and the pull-through rows mostly empty; recent reviews describe overnight stops ('quick night stop during long drives'). Nightly share looks well over half -> no caveat needed in my read.
SITE COUNT: stored 35 (from RV Life via note) unconfirmed by the operator; a Google reviewer says 'About 20 sites'. Cleared.

BOOKING: no online engine; reservations by phone (307-334-3174). Not written as a booking group since the operator never states reservations are taken; one review reports a same-day phone reservation.
Note trimmed: amperage, hookups, rig length, showers/laundry are fields; 'coffee shop' not on the current site, dropped.
PIN fine: stored 42.74815,-104.48737 is at the office/entrance (Google 42.74817,-104.48733).
